continents.name: Europe
continents.blurb: Compact distances, fast trains, and a mix of historic capitals and coastal towns.
continents.bestTime: April–June and September–October for mild weather and fewer crowds.

continents.name: North America
continents.blurb: Vast distances best covered by domestic flights, from Arctic Canada to sunbelt cities.
continents.bestTime: May–June and September–October avoid both summer crowds and winter cold.

continents.name: Asia
continents.blurb: Ancient heritage sites alongside some of the world's densest, fastest-moving cities.
continents.bestTime: March–May and September–November for mild temperatures across most of the region.

continents.name: Middle East
continents.blurb: Modern skylines and desert landscapes, with some of the highest luxury hotel density anywhere.
continents.bestTime: November–March, avoiding the intense summer heat.

continents.name: Africa
continents.blurb: Coastal capitals, ancient history, and safari gateways across a hugely varied continent.
continents.bestTime: Varies widely by region — check each country's dry season before booking.

continents.name: Oceania
continents.blurb: Harbourfront cities and beach towns, best reached with some flexibility on travel time.
continents.bestTime: March–May and September–November for mild weather nationwide.
